Hi Leah — great to hear and congrats on the application. Short answers up front:
- Typical promo: $5k of hosted API credit + 3 months of priority onboarding.
- We do accept accelerator partner nominations for a one-time uplift (up to $15k) on a case-by-case basis with a short qualification checklist and partner approval.

I attached a lightweight checklist to speed things along — it covers company stage, expected monthly token volume, basic security posture (SOC2 / data residency needs), and a short integration timeline. If you can return that, Priyom (cc'd) will validate the fit and loop in Partnerships for the uplift approval.

Next steps:
1) Fill and return the attached checklist.
2) We'll confirm SOC/GDPR items (if applicable).
3) Partnerships reviews for any uplift > $5k.

If useful I can also provide a pre-filled usage estimate based on the demo flows you showed.

Thanks — talk soon.

Rishi Malhotra
